meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 激活高强度工作模式,让 AI 助手在会话中遵循你的全部规则。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你使用 Codex 编程,并希望 AI 严格按你的规则执行。
copy.tagline_en: Turn on power mode to make the AI follow all your rules for the rest of the task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want your AI to strictly follow your working guidelines.

howto.what: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”时,Claude 进入严格编码模式:先显示 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,再按固定流程工作——划定任务轻重、建立目标、记录笔记,用“先写失败测试再实现”的方式逐项完成,并亲手验证真实效果。
howto.when: 当你的指令里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发;若任务涉及数据库改动、安全代码、接口联调等高风险内容,还会自动升级到更严的检查流程。

say.text: ultrawork:修复登录接口返回 500 的错误,先写失败测试再改。
用 ulw 模式给这个项目加一个用户列表页面,走完整 QA 验证。
say.note: 会建目标清单和 notepad,逐项执行并留证据。

say.text: ultrawork,审查这些改动是否达标,并用浏览器亲手验证。
say.note: 会核对成功标准,并在真实浏览器里操作。

howto.what_en: When you say 'ultrawork' or 'ulw', Claude enters strict coding mode: prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then plans via notepad and goal tools, and completes tasks test-first with real-surface verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. For high-risk changes (DB schema, auth/security code, external integrations), it automatically upgrades to a stricter review process.

say_en.text: ultrawork: fix the login endpoint 500 error, write failing test first then fix.
say_en.note: It prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! and starts test-first.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to add a user list page to this project and run full QA.
say_en.note: It logs goals in a notepad and executes step by step.

say_en.text: ultrawork: review these changes against criteria and verify in a real browser.
say_en.note: It checks the criteria and operates the browser itself.
